caption: The drawing features a symmetrical geometric pattern composed of two intersecting circular forms, each made up of numerous overlapping black lines that create intricate, lace-like, and swirling shapes. The two main circular shapes overlap at their edges and share a common central area, where the density of lines is greater, resulting in a darker, more solid appearance. Each circular section contains repeated, spiral patterns as well as some open, oval-shaped areas. The background of the drawing is a solid, off-white or beige color, and the entire pattern is centered on the page. In the lower right area beneath the design, there is a small, handwritten signature in black ink.
title: Brooch
